basics.name: Shivam Kumar
basics.label: Senior Systems Engineer at Qualcomm
basics.summary: Systems engineer with a strong DSP and wireless background (5G NR, Wi-Fi, mmWave, ISAC) now focused on XR edge AI — deploying and optimizing quantized VLMs and low-power multimodal pipelines on Snapdragon XR platforms. Skilled in latency, memory, and power optimization for wearables, with hands-on experience in Python/C++, PyTorch, and embedded prototyping on Raspberry Pi and ESP32.

work.name: Qualcomm Research India
work.position: Senior Systems Engineer — XR Edge-AI Optimization
work.summary: Project: VLM on Glass — real-time multimodal conversational AI on Snapdragon XR smart glasses.
highlights: Optimized and deployed a quantized Vision-Language Model (VLM) on Snapdragon XR smart glasses for real-time multimodal conversational AI under strict latency, memory, and power constraints.
Designed quantization-aware calibration pipelines, improving model accuracy (~16% gain on TextVQA) while validating efficient 8/16-bit deployment strategies for edge devices.
Conducted end-to-end system profiling (camera → preprocessing → model → speech output), cutting perceived latency to ~3s and pinpointing key performance bottlenecks.
Led power-performance optimization, reducing battery drain (~4.4% → ~2.8% per minute) and extending runtime (~22 → ~36 minutes).
Contributed to a low-power AI (LPAI) architecture enabling always-on speech recognition via NPU/DSP offloading while minimizing CPU usage.
Supported multimodal interaction pipelines (voice, camera, sensors) and scalable deployment of on-device ASR models for continuous user interaction.

work.name: Qualcomm Research India
work.position: PHY-Layer Systems Engineer — 5G-Advanced Positioning & 6G ISAC (Location Technology)
work.summary: Project: Location and positioning estimation using the 5G network.
highlights: Developed ML-based positioning solutions using 5G signals, achieving ~10 m accuracy without GPS in challenging environments.
Built data pipelines and PyTorch models to estimate location from wireless signal measurements.
Filed 40 patents on advanced positioning, multi-device collaboration, and sensing techniques.
Worked on LEO satellite navigation and sensing solutions for improved accuracy and tracking.

work.name: Qualcomm Research India
work.summary: Project: Wi-Fi 8 (60 GHz + sub-6 GHz) prototype development.
highlights: Designed and simulated an end-to-end communication system including waveform design and signal-quality estimation under real-world impairments.
Contributed to hardware and firmware development, including signal-processing blocks, synchronization, and RF communication control.
Built Python automation tools for data analysis and debugging of RTL and firmware.
Improved beam-tracking performance in high-mobility scenarios by integrating sub-6 GHz assistance.

work.name: Qualcomm Research India
work.summary: Project: Downlink MU-MIMO precoding for Wi-Fi 8.
highlights: Studied and simulated Tomlinson-Harashima Precoding (THP), a non-linear method based on self-interference cancellation.
Benchmarked THP against linear precoding with end-to-end WLAN simulations, achieving throughput gains over the linear MMSE precoder.

work.name: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC)
work.summary: Offshore crude-oil processing platform, Bombay High.
highlights: Managed and designed power-system infrastructure from generation to distribution on an offshore crude-oil processing platform in Bombay High.

work.name: Samsung Research Institute, Bengaluru
work.summary: Natural-language number recognition for the Bixby AI assistant.
highlights: Enhanced the numeric-recognition capability of Samsung's Bixby assistant, which previously used a rule-based method to detect numbers in user prompts.
